state:Andhra Pradesh.text: Andhra Pradesh has pursued major infrastructure investments, approving massive hyperscale AI data centers and green data center projects with companies like Google and Reliance, alongside plans for specialized technology and quantum universities [R42588509, R1349768b, R3eefbde9]. The state government has integrated artificial intelligence across multiple public sectors, deploying AI models for tourism assistance, municipal flood forecasting, police monitoring, and tax administration [Rccf3ba89, Ra460605d, R84d949ed, R6e71a6d9]. Furthermore, Andhra Pradesh has emphasized widespread educational reform and workforce skilling by introducing AI curricula in schools, mandatory teacher training, and large-scale youth training partnerships with technology leaders [Ra4163b0a, R9fe15d9b, Re98842fe].

state:Bihar.text: The Government of Bihar has actively pursued artificial intelligence adoption across governance, public services, and education through strategic partnerships with major technology firms like Google and Microsoft [R57e2c2ec, Rbd5780f9]. The state has launched key initiatives focused on modernizing education by training teachers in AI, introducing AI-powered learning programs, and planning comprehensive AI curricula in schools and universities [Reb7bfdb3, R744a92d0, Re18a3100]. Additionally, AI applications are being integrated into infrastructure monitoring, public health call centers, agriculture, and administrative operations such as the paperless e-Cabinet system [R93fdc627, R79e87d3a, Ra12ea795, Re986d143].

state:Gujarat.text: The Government of Gujarat has actively advanced artificial intelligence through infrastructure development, targeted governance applications, and educational initiatives. Key infrastructure efforts include the establishment of AI and data center clusters near GIFT City [Rb322fa47, R42b5efe9], a statewide GPU-as-a-Service framework [Rd1b68bba], and the Data Centre Policy 2026-29 aiming for Green AI capacity and mandatory renewable power integration [Re041bd74, R0d737a25, R43f4ae2b]. State governance is leveraging AI across sectors such as agricultural paddy quality testing [Re71562c3], dairy farming guidance via the Amul AI platform [Ra310e3fc], police surveillance challenges [R28ccc09b], and student dropout prevention [R88fee491]. Additionally, the state has initiated a major student training mission targeting 5 lakh students and thousands of faculty members [Ra6932da2], while the Gujarat High Court has concurrently enacted policies prohibiting AI use in judicial decision-making and judgment drafting [Rbd9766bd].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across governance, education, and industry through targeted infrastructure projects and strategic partnerships [R65d60606, R2c127a87]. The state has established multiple Centres of Excellence, launched specialized AI hubs, and introduced digital initiatives like affordable AI-ready computers and voice-based citizen service platforms [R3590a0eb, Re78dfed2, Ra61ec765]. Educational reforms form a core pillar of this activity, featuring early tech training in government schools, vocational AI subjects, and plans for a dedicated artificial intelligence university [R8176ca19, R3e7508f6, R6abb0164]. Furthermore, the government has formed dedicated committees for ethical AI governance and collaborated with global tech entities to expand its deep-tech ecosystem [R65d60606, R9b3c768e].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through comprehensive policy approvals, significant infrastructure investments, and targeted governance frameworks [R562864e1, R03b6b6d6]. The state cabinet approved an AI policy backed by a ₹10,000 crore investment plan and established dedicated oversight committees and a new IT-AI department [R562864e1, Rd7d40f74, R5afedf9c]. Key initiatives span multiple sectors, including the deployment of 'Maha AI' for governance, Sarvam AI tools for government operations, and partnerships with technology firms for green data centres and AI innovation hubs [R68fee1a0, Re0b416d1, R03b6b6d6]. Additionally, the state has integrated AI into public services, policing, education, and agriculture through specialized platforms and pilot projects [R04592b70, R44b25a30, Rcd594eaf].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha has actively advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, infrastructure, and education under the Artificial Intelligence Policy 2025 [Rc729937b]. The state government launched unified WhatsApp chatbots like 'Ama Sathi' and 'Ama Rasta' to streamline public service delivery, revenue access, and road safety incident reporting [Rabdf8555, R374a9b99]. Additionally, Odisha has pursued massive infrastructure projects, approving major investments for AI-optimized data centers, semiconductor units, and sovereign compute parks alongside partnerships with firms like Sarvam AI and HCLTech [R31b27cb7, R00b3c6a6, R230b6e3b]. Furthermore, the state has integrated AI training and courses into higher education curricula and implemented automated monitoring solutions in sectors such as wildlife protection, transport enforcement, and public administration [Rdb5da3c5, R8a2dd09f, R52b2a7e8, R7c97b171].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued widespread integration of artificial intelligence across education, governance, agriculture, and law enforcement. The state education system introduced AI as a core and mainstream curriculum subject in government schools for classes ranging from Class I to XII [Rf6319e99, Re45fa955, R5c2eec42]. Concurrently, law enforcement agencies deployed AI-powered tools, voice recognition systems, and smart command centers in partnership with IIT Ropar to track criminals and dismantle organized crime [R7333c0ad, R132d8a77, Re289fcd5]. State initiatives also leveraged AI for agricultural advisory services, healthcare screening, and infrastructure monitoring [R609b6fc5, Ree614b14, R4e4970c3].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has driven extensive artificial intelligence adoption through infrastructure developments, public service automation, and targeted educational initiatives. Key infrastructure projects include partnering to establish a Sovereign AI Park, inaugurating South India's largest AI-ready data center campus, and collaborating with IIT Madras to create an AI Data Centre and state-owned GPU cluster [R472c3c1a, R70cb396d, R305828a2, R8b2c535d]. The state has enhanced public service delivery by deploying WhatsApp chatbots like 'Namma Arasu' for government services and launching AI systems for wildlife conservation, healthcare appointment booking, and policing [R494484b4, R31409be3, R576baa19, R76baa146]. Furthermore, Tamil Nadu has integrated AI into its education system by training government school students and teachers, launching specialized AI learning platforms, and introducing AI trades in vocational training institutes [R9cd35018, Rfe24cede, Re04bb5c4, R5742a9b1].

state:Telangana.text: Telangana has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across infrastructure, governance, and public services through strategic partnerships and institutional initiatives [Rd6f74125, R389847d5]. The state has attracted massive investments in AI-ready data centers and advanced technology clusters, including major projects by Microsoft, CtrlS, and NTT Data [Ra0d04f11, Rd164dad2, Rc056fe14]. In governance and public administration, AI is deployed to enhance policing, monitor traffic, streamline transport testing, plug GST leakages, and improve agricultural market transparency [Ra1409382, Rce4536fa, R4ac51e57, R849548ed, R45e372bd]. Furthermore, the government has prioritized widespread AI skilling and literacy initiatives targeting millions of students and government employees across the state [R6843cc3b, R3bfd0d73, R89c590e8, R59295049].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: Uttar Pradesh has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure projects, governance initiatives, and large-scale skilling programs [R7945996b]. The state cabinet approved the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission alongside data center and robotics policies aimed at establishing AI hubs and attracting multi-billion-dollar investments in cities like Lucknow and Noida [Rb1cbd4df, Rb312992b, R398131aa]. Furthermore, the government has integrated AI into public administration and exam monitoring, while partnering with major tech firms to train millions of youth in emerging technologies [Re0c4ff32, Rf4058825, R1a841461].

category:strategy_policy.text: Indian state governments have heavily prioritized artificial intelligence through comprehensive strategy documents, dedicated missions, and institutional frameworks. Major states like Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Bihar have approved specific AI policies or missions backed by substantial planned investments and multi-year training targets for youth and students [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, R4af400f2, Rb312992b]. Additionally, states are investing in specialized infrastructure by planning AI cities, data center policies, green AI data centers, and tech hubs in locations like Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, and Gujarat [R1b6cbab3, R3eefbde9, Re041bd74, R398131aa]. Governance and public service delivery are also being transformed as states adopt AI for tasks ranging from revenue collection and traffic management to agricultural market tracking and disaster resilience [R849548ed, R8edb04a8, R3391f5dc, R45e372bd]. Furthermore, educational reforms feature prominently, with several administrations introducing early schooling AI modules, specialized university proposals, and workforce skilling initiatives [R2c0df2e5, Rb77b1a7f, Rdf96f436].

category:regulation_ethics.text: State governments and judiciaries have increasingly focused on regulating artificial intelligence to address ethical concerns, data privacy, and the risks of misuse in public administration. Several high courts, including those in Gujarat, Kerala, and Punjab and Haryana, have issued policies prohibiting or restricting the use of AI tools in judicial decision-making, judgment drafting, and legal research [Rbd9766bd, R12b7585e, R8eacd504]. Concurrently, states like Karnataka, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan have introduced committees, frameworks, and protocols to promote responsible AI adoption, combat deepfakes, and safeguard citizen data [R9b3c768e, Rba8badb1, R8039f374]. Furthermore, specific departments in states such as Telangana have restricted officers from uploading confidential taxpayer information to unauthorized AI platforms to maintain data security [R607d069a].

category:funding_budget.text: Indian state governments have launched substantial financial commitments and funding mechanisms to drive artificial intelligence infrastructure, data centers, and specialized missions. Notable initiatives include multi-year state missions and large-scale infrastructure investments, such as Chhattisgarh's Rs 500 crore AI Mission and Uttar Pradesh's multi-crore AI and skill development programs [R7cc53f61, Rb312992b, R297b1b1d]. States are also attracting massive private capital and international partnerships for high-capacity data centers and sovereign compute projects, ranging from large agreements in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh to major proposals in Maharashtra and Bihar [Rd3f465ac, R3eefbde9, R00b3c6a6, R3a36bb44]. Additionally, funds are being directed toward sector-specific applications such as agriculture, wildlife protection, and workforce skilling to integrate AI across public governance and higher education [R68fee1a0, Radc0ac36, R5c8784f8, R311c8976].

category:infrastructure.text: State governments across India have actively driven AI infrastructure development through major investments in data centers, hyperscale campuses, and dedicated technology hubs. States like Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh, and Odisha have secured massive private investments for gigawatt-scale AI data centers, sovereign compute projects, and specialized AI cities [R31b27cb7, R5b4a7a80, R42588509, R398131aa, R00b3c6a6]. Additionally, multiple states are establishing AI universities, research centers of excellence, and specialized parks—such as robotics hubs and GPUaaS frameworks—to bolster local tech ecosystems, skilling, and public sector innovation [Rc16dddf8, R2d894836, Rb1cbd4df, Rd1b68bba, Ra4c0792f].

category:partnership.text: State governments across India have actively pursued partnerships and Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with global technology firms and institutions to drive artificial intelligence infrastructure, skill development, and governance initiatives [R44971ae6, R84a7e58c]. Major investments focus heavily on establishing large-scale AI data centers and hyperscale hubs, with prominent projects announced in states like Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Telangana by companies such as Google, Reliance, IBM, and TCS [R5b4a7a80, R42588509, R1349768b, Reff5d158, Re0b416d1]. Additionally, several states including Bihar, Karnataka, and Maharashtra have partnered with organizations like Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, and ElevenLabs to integrate AI into public services, healthcare, and educational programs, spanning teacher training and youth skill development [Reb7bfdb3, R65d60606, R2889d124, Rff273deb]. Other regional collaborations range from multilingual AI partnerships with BHASHINI in Manipur to crime-tracking AI initiatives with IIT Ropar in Punjab [Rad868781, R132d8a77].

category:deployment.text: Indian state governments are actively deploying artificial intelligence across diverse sectors such as public service delivery, law enforcement, education, and healthcare [Rd731fc75, R3590a0eb, R04592b70, Rd2e6b41c]. Significant initiatives include conversational AI chatbots for citizen services via WhatsApp, AI-powered surveillance and transcription tools in the justice and police systems, and specialized educational computers and digital platforms [Rabdf8555, R04592b70, Rd2e6b41c, Rf2c35456]. States are also leveraging AI for administrative efficiency, revenue monitoring, and regional language preservation through partnerships with major technology companies and public entities [Rd731fc75, Rad868781, Rccf3ba89, R6e1a6d9].

category:skilling.text: State governments across India are widely integrating artificial intelligence and emerging technology skilling into school and higher education curricula, establishing AI labs, and launching dedicated state AI missions. Prominent initiatives include comprehensive student training targets, such as Bihar's plan to train 5 lakh students and Uttar Pradesh's broad programs targeting millions of youth [R4af400f2, R1a841461, R6890e754]. States like Punjab, Karnataka, and Maharashtra have introduced AI as mainstream, vocational, or mandatory subjects and initiated extensive teacher training programs in partnership with major technology firms like Google and Microsoft [Rf6319e99, R3e7508f6, R2889d124, R481bc633]. Furthermore, specialized skilling centers, centers of excellence, and specialized regional bootcamps are being deployed to foster technical capabilities and digital literacy among diverse demographics, including rural and tribal students [R998e03d5, R19745493, R8ae280e0].

category:events_outreach.text: State governments across India have actively organized summits, tech conferences, and workshops focused on artificial intelligence, such as the Bengaluru Tech Summit in Karnataka, the Global AI Summit in Telangana, and regional AI impact conferences in states like Uttar Pradesh, Odisha, and Uttarakhand [Rec3b838b, R1dd96b45, R4348031c, Re9890866]. Authorities have also engaged youth and students through specialized programs, including hackathons, boot camps, and skill initiatives launched in Gujarat, Tripura, Assam, and Maharashtra [Rb8c534c6, R3fff65a8, R28ccc09b, Rcb537fcf]. Additionally, events frequently explore sector-specific AI applications in areas like agriculture, healthcare, policing, and digital governance [R12d4ab71, R28ccc09b, R43b389dd, R0c438654].

state:Kerala.text: Kerala has integrated artificial intelligence extensively across governance, education, law enforcement, and public services, highlighted by the rebranding of its IT department to focus on AI and future technologies [Ref58a154, R0182578b]. The state has launched major infrastructure and startup initiatives, including twin AI Centres of Excellence, a Rs. 50 crore Gen-Z startup fund, and substantial investments in AI-driven data centers and regional AI hubs [Re3333cd0, Rcaa18758, Ra525c46d]. Educational reforms feature mandatory robotics training, AI-based teaching assistants, and large-scale teacher training programs [R0689eb15, R3db21292, Rc3656b09]. Additionally, AI tools are deployed for public safety, traffic monitoring, judiciary transcription, healthcare screening, and disaster and wildlife management [R12b7585e, Rf2c35456, Rf97b9af4, R3e1be3fe, R07d9ae93].

category:governance_body.text: Several Indian states have established high-level governance structures, ministerial portfolios, and specialized administrative bodies to oversee artificial intelligence policy and adoption [R6bbe2d82, R3f8abae4, Rfb71877d]. Kerala and Tamil Nadu created dedicated AI ministerial positions and restructured their information technology departments to focus on artificial intelligence and future technologies [R6bbe2d82, Ref58a154, Ref475c84]. Other states such as Maharashtra, Gujarat, Karnataka, and Bihar have formed targeted committees, task forces, and special cells to manage AI policy implementation, ethical governance, and sector-specific applications [R3f8abae4, R301d6af1, R9b3c768e, Rfb71877d]. Additionally, police and law enforcement agencies in states like Telangana, West Bengal, Haryana, and Jharkhand have moved to create specialized AI units and task forces for tech-driven policing [Ra1409382, Re268e526, Ra6b5d331, R25c27df1].

overall.text: Indian state governments have widely engaged in AI policy activity by implementing specialized state AI policies, establishing major data centers and infrastructure projects, and launching educational initiatives [R6a6bee70, R42588509, Rf6319e99]. Notable infrastructure and investment developments include Maharashtra approving an AI Policy with a planned investment of ₹10,000 crore, and major data center or AI city initiatives planned in states such as Tamil Nadu, Odisha, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh [R31b27cb7, R1b6cbab3, R5b4a7a80, R562864e1, R42588509]. States have also integrated AI into public services, governance, and law enforcement, through applications like AI copilots for police, voice portals for regional languages, and automated portals for tracking public administration tasks [Rd731fc75, R04592b70, R3158dd4a]. Additionally, several states have focused on human capital by introducing AI subjects in schools, launching teacher capacity-building programs, and establishing AI skill development boot camps [Rf6319e99, R27258895, Rc119f335].

state:Assam.text: Assam has actively pursued an AI-driven transformation across governance, education, healthcare, and infrastructure, mapping hundreds of proposals and commissioning a government-owned GPU cluster to power state services [R936eb0aa, R416e5d33]. Key initiatives include deploying artificial intelligence for flood rescue via WhatsApp, forest encroachment and deforestation monitoring, and wildlife protection through automated train collision alerts and monitoring systems [Rc2490b65, R9c52da90, R037e76ac, Rddd6a227, R692a244d]. The state has also integrated AI tools into schools and teacher training programs in partnership with Google and UNICEF, alongside introducing AI anchors and administrative systems like 'ALISA' [R5a187c0b, R39b50ddb, Re167bad2, R68e89c81].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh has advanced its digital and technological capabilities through the establishment of the Chhattisgarh AI Mission, backed by a Rs 500 crore investment over five years, alongside significant infrastructure projects like proposed AI data center parks and special economic zones [R7cc53f61, Rcc6c8e84, Rd28b546d]. The state government has integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, implementing AI-driven applications for wildlife conservation, rural road monitoring, and public service operations like police investigations and salary audits [R96ea213d, Reb028d74, 1dec6260, Re3198684]. Furthermore, educational and workforce development initiatives have been rolled out, including partnerships with Google to train over two lakh teachers and the introduction of AI and coding modules for students in tribal and remote areas [R398fad0d, Ra5541f51, Rf7c7fd70].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, law enforcement, education, and agriculture, supported by partnerships with organizations like the World Bank [R08e27cff, R56704031]. Major infrastructure plans include establishing AI hubs in Gurugram and Panchkula, an AI data centre, and an AI sandbox for public service pilots [Ra92a52de, R03b25e4d, R4b3be64a]. Law enforcement and governance have integrated AI for cybercrime tracking, financial fraud monitoring, and automated surveillance [R00f487ea, R770d942f, Rdb9464b3], while education and training initiatives introduce AI labs and skill programmes in schools and industrial training institutes [R1cd067ec, R01ac3f97]. Furthermore, the state applies AI to agriculture and healthcare through digital soil mapping, disease screening, and weather intelligence tools [Rf90e65a4, Rb4ae5aa0, R8677362d].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh has actively integrated artificial intelligence across education, governance, and public services, including the launch of digital learning tools like the 'Padhai with AI' app in Bilaspur and the incorporation of AI curricula in schools [Rb23a865a, Rbc10366f]. The state government has advanced AI-driven administrative systems, such as document verification on the Him Seva Portal and meeting management platforms, alongside healthcare initiatives like robotic-assisted surgeries and AI fraud-detection in the Himcare scheme [R38e56e62, R1ba6a5ba, Rc3a3d3b4, Reb98bbcd]. Furthermore, institutional collaborations with bodies like IIT Mandi have driven projects in forest intelligence, ecological restoration, disaster resilience, and deepfake detection [Rd81af6f6, Re6fc0429, R26835c79, Rc06b19cc].

state:Jharkhand.text: Jharkhand has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, healthcare, education, and infrastructure, anchored by the launch of the Jharkhand AI Policy 2026 and the Jharkhand AI Vision-2050 roadmap [R4b4e0b34, R927ec078]. The state government has integrated AI into public administration and public safety, utilizing AI-based cameras, drones, and surveillance systems for crowd monitoring during events and wildlife tracking to mitigate human-animal conflicts [R96eaad17, R558f4a5f, R118b938d]. Furthermore, healthcare and education sectors are seeing substantial modernization, including digital health conclaves, AI-powered learning platforms in schools, and new AI training programs for officials and students [Rd25878d1, Rfd41fa83, R36a0ee65, Rb74fac99].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh is actively integrating artificial intelligence across public administration, infrastructure development, and economic planning under Chief Minister Mohan Yadav's leadership. Key initiatives include partnering with Google Cloud for AI-driven governance, attracting major investments for AI-ready data centers and chip packaging facilities, and deploying AI surveillance for crowd management during the Simhastha 2028 preparations [R12d4ab71, R6473839f, Rac12a0cd, R4df0843d]. Additionally, the state has applied AI to real-time forest and environmental monitoring, public transport optimization, and civic procurement auditing [Rc8beb73d, R7c96135c, R4c96f220].

state:Manipur.text: Manipur has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, legal proceedings, and conservation efforts [Rbb7d36a7, Rc647f8ab, R7249ca9d]. Notable initiatives include the Manipur High Court utilizing AI tools like ChatGPT for judicial research and landmark verdicts, alongside partnerships with BHASHINI and Microsoft to expand multilingual AI, cybersecurity, and digital governance [Rad868781, Rdc31ca32, R647a600d]. The state has also promoted AI in academic and career settings through workshops, university programs, and the opening of an AI career guidance hub in an Imphal school [Rbb7d36a7, R546f135d, R13590541]. Furthermore, AI applications are being explored for wildlife trafficking prevention, tribal development, and digital tourism [R7249ca9d, R3413274d, Re9f95033].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, education, agriculture, and public health, positioning itself as a leader in tech-driven development [Radc3741c, Rf1f88f85, R84a1eeb7]. Significant actions include drafting a new IT policy focused on AI and global capability centres, proposing a Rs 20 crore AI Centre of Excellence at Shillong Technology Park Phase II, and introducing AI-enabled learning initiatives in schools [R9625f972, Rf277c3a3, R24be49c9]. Additionally, the state has leveraged data-driven governance to improve public health metrics, deployed AI solutions for environmental and waste management, and hosted the Regional Artificial Intelligence Impact Conference [Rac5495f0, Rd7994ab1, R84a1eeb7].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura has undertaken extensive initiatives to integrate artificial intelligence across governance, public administration, and law enforcement, including deploying AI-based tools for tax evasion detection, traffic management, and police control rooms [Ra65da593, R8edb04a8, Rdc265ce0]. The state is launching a state-level AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur to build a robust local technology and innovation ecosystem [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. Furthermore, Tripura has emphasized AI-driven advancements in education, healthcare, and agriculture, such as introducing free AI courses for school students, AI-powered school monitoring, and AI medical equipment [R2235629e, R3fff65a8, R20047d48, R12023632].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has actively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through high-profile events such as the Uttarakhand AI Impact Summit and the Devbhoomi AI Summit to position the state as a hub for responsible technology and governance [R2d4fffde, R8a719696]. The government has integrated AI into public administration, leveraging machine learning and computer vision to curb tax evasion, monitor illegal mining, automate cyber fraud helpline responses, and secure the uniform civil code portal [Recb1f69d, R549f779d, Rd3b15ea6, Rc3235cc0]. In the environmental and wildlife sectors, the state employs AI-powered cameras, acoustic surveillance systems, and intrusion detection tools to mitigate human-wildlife conflicts and manage forests [R994e0e10, R82962675, Rf32d6d42]. Furthermore, educational integration features prominently through AI literacy programs in schools, new engineering curricula, and university partnerships to train youth and educators [Rb0eb9126, R42cd5368, Rcea6d545]. ecosystem.

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal is actively advancing artificial intelligence integration across industrial, governance, and educational sectors. The state has accelerated projects like the Silicon Valley initiative, drafted industrial policies focusing on AI and data centres, and launched the West Bengal AI Mission [Rf93d2652, R0c1ea7de, R90ad9af5]. In education and workforce development, authorities have introduced AI and data science into school curricula, partnered with Oracle to train thousands of students, and set up specialized labs [Rac4428c1, R6da26467, R81dbfce7]. Furthermore, law enforcement and civic administration are adopting AI through dedicated police cells, investigation apps, surveillance training, and explorations into urban infrastructure services [Re268e526, Rebcdd9ec, R5118fef0, R08e415eb].

state:Rajasthan.text: The Rajasthan government has advanced artificial intelligence integration across multiple sectors, highlighted by the approval of the AI-ML Policy 2026 and initiatives such as free foundational AI courses for citizens [R6a6bee70, R2c694631]. Strategic partnerships and MoUs have been established with organizations like Wadhwani AI to drive technological applications in agriculture, healthcare, and public administration [R6de84b70, R1603c33d]. Additionally, the state has adopted AI tools for public safety, traffic management, wildlife tracking, and grievance redressal through platforms like Rajasthan Sampark [Rd7e6b721, Rc8ca6b6e, R311c8976, Rcaf01e51].

state:Nagaland.text: Nagaland has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, public administration, and specialized sectors such as disaster preparedness, agriculture, law enforcement, and animal production [Ra8c17a13, R3a286812, R17676278, Rbf1aee2c]. Significant initiatives include launching an AI supercomputer, an AI-powered digital agriculture ecosystem, police surveillance cameras, and award-winning WhatsApp chatbots to improve public services and skill development access [Ra8c17a13, R3a286812, R1ee21379, R17676278, Rb26a6b87]. The state has also prioritized education and capacity building through the inauguration of an AI Centre of Excellence for Skilling, faculty development workshops, and plans to introduce an AI curriculum in schools starting from Class 6 [R6f55ee54, Rb7d1d850, R8b9ea930, Ree819f7b].

state:Sikkim.text: Sikkim has actively integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, most notably deploying an AI-driven Traffic Management System and e-challan mechanisms to enhance road safety and manage traffic congestion [Re7e20a6f, R24fc93a2, Ref56657c]. In education and agriculture, the state has launched AI-powered learning programs in government schools, partnered with NIELIT Gangtok to establish an AI Centre of Excellence, and pilot-tested an AI-enabled WhatsApp chatbot to support farmers [R27258895, Red4520ff, R2569fc2d]. Additionally, the government has advanced technology adoption by introducing an AI-based permit system to boost tourism and discussing AI applications for disaster prediction and higher education partnerships [Rfc6c0173, Rb685bb8f, R604d927c].
